copy.headline: Live video sells. Most brands still run it manually.
copy.subhead: Scheduling, moderation and checkout in one operating surface.

plate_direction: A deep navy ground, near flat. In the lower half, a real live-video broadcast console shown on a monitor: a video preview beside a chat stream and product cards, genuine interface, not invented UI. Large periwinkle circles and one wide arc frame the screen, with a single thin light line crossing behind it. High contrast, generous whitespace, crisp product surfaces. The upper half is unbroken navy, entirely free of detail.
